title: Radiology Registry on Pancreatic Malignancies
summary: The purpose of this study is to collect all radiological data which evaluated with clinical data may help assess malignancy and prognosis of pancreatic disease.This registry aims to collect retrospective data from 2014 and prospective data until 2027 with a maximum follow-up of 3 years per patient.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥18 years of age
* Patients with suspect (planned for investigation) or diagnosed pancreatic cancer at any stage.
* able and willing to sign informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with non-primary pancreatic disease
